title: Samantha Lewis
description: Samantha is an Accredited Specialist in Family Law. Samantha takes a pragmatic approach through listening and understanding her clients.
jobTitle: Senior Associate – Accredited Specialist in Family Law
html:
Samantha Lewis is an Accredited Specialist in Family Law. Samantha has been practising law for a decade and has extensive experience in Family Law in a wide range of areas including:

  • Complex property proceedings including high net worth clients with corporate structures
  • Parenting disputes
  • Spousal maintenance
  • Injunctions including exclusive occupation of matrimonial homes
  • Drafting Financial Agreements (pre-nups)
  • Setting aside Financial Agreements
  • Interstate and International Relocation
  • Urgent recovery orders to recover children from interstate
  • Disputes involving domestic violence and high conflict personalities

Samantha takes a pragmatic approach in all of her matters through listening and understanding her clients to ensure clients receive the best professional legal service with successful and swift resolutions. All options for settlement are explored, not just litigation. Having a background working for families recovering their children from FACS and appearing in criminal proceedings, Samantha shows a high level of empathy that reassures her clients that they are receiving expert advice from their lawyer who truly cares about the outcomes for her clients.

Samantha is a member of the Law Society and the Family Law Section of the Law Council of Australia.
